precondition: A fresh task-local fixture exists and the real debug LifeOS P3-104.app is launched through macOS LaunchServices.
operation: Open the actual Tauri app and wait for its first backend get_today response without clicking a capture action.
observable_result: The default-recovery page reports no records, AI disabled, and waits for explicit confirmation.

precondition: The actual Tauri app is running with a backend-owned one-record state.
operation: Click the navigation links from default recovery to no-reliable-suggestion and restricted-offline.
observable_result: All three real pages open and show a consistent backend-owned state and explicit content/AI boundaries.

precondition: The actual app reports zero records for the fresh fixed fixture.
operation: Click 明确确认本地保存 once.
observable_result: Success appears only after atomic SQLite publication; today shows one user-original record and one saved audit event.

precondition: The fixed primary record has already been saved once.
operation: Click 重复同一幂等操作 with the same fixed key and text.
observable_result: The backend returns idempotent repeat, record count remains one, and a legal repeat audit is appended.

precondition: The fixed primary key is bound to its original fixed text.
operation: Click 验证同 key 异文本阻断.
observable_result: The backend discloses idempotency_conflict; records and audit remain one and two.

precondition: The authoritative database contains the one valid record and two valid audit events.
operation: Click 验证原子失败 to invoke the fixed backend failure probe.
observable_result: The backend discloses injected_atomic_failure, does not show success, and authoritative counts remain unchanged.

precondition: The page displays a disclosed injected failure while the backend still owns one valid record.
operation: Activate the default-recovery navigation link to reload the page from backend state.
observable_result: The transient failure disclosure disappears and get_today restores exactly one record and two audit events.

precondition: The actual app has one persisted fixed record and two valid audit events.
operation: Quit the app with super+q, confirm the process stopped, relaunch the same debug app, and read the first page.
observable_result: After a real close/reopen, get_today restores one user-original record and two audit events from SQLite.

precondition: The actual app is on the restricted-offline page.
operation: Read runtime_status in the page and inspect open sockets with lsof while the app is running.
observable_result: The renderer reports zero direct capabilities, exact three-command allowlist, all external capabilities closed; lsof finds no app socket.

precondition: The actual restricted-offline page has one record and two audit events.
operation: Invoke an unknown command, then invoke all registered commands with extra path, SQL, and shell fields.
observable_result: Unknown IPC and every extra field are denied; backend records and audit are unchanged.

precondition: The actual no-reliable-suggestion page is open with the persisted backend record.
operation: Click 选择 Project and then 记录停点.
observable_result: Both actions stop locally with explicit user-control text; no suggestion or new record is generated.

precondition: The actual default-recovery page is at the top and has no pointer-focused control.
operation: Press the physical Tab key through computer-use.
observable_result: The skip link becomes visible with a high-contrast focus outline.

precondition: The visible skip link has focus after an actual Tab press.
operation: Press the physical Enter key through computer-use.
observable_result: The skip link activates and the actual app scrolls/focuses the main-content region.

precondition: The actual app window is at its initial 1024-pixel configured width.
operation: Return the real default page to the top and capture the wide layout.
observable_result: Hierarchy, navigation, identity boundary, and backend state remain readable without overlap.

precondition: The actual app is at its wide default size with authoritative state visible.
operation: Use the native Window > Move & Resize > Left action to make the actual window narrow and capture it.
observable_result: At the narrower 676-pixel captured window, content reflows without clipping and backend state is preserved.

precondition: macOS Reduce Motion is initially off and the app reports that the system has not requested it.
operation: Temporarily enable Reduce Motion in System Settings, navigate the actual app to restricted-offline, capture its status, then restore the setting to off.
observable_result: The app reports 系统已启用 while the CSS reduced-motion rule disables transitions/animations; the original system preference is restored.

precondition: The actual app is stopped and the exact evidence fixture contains only capture.sqlite and sentinel.txt.
operation: Run cleanup_evidence_fixture.sh and scan /private/tmp for lifeos-p3-104-* residue.
observable_result: The exact app fixture is removed and no task-prefixed temporary fixture remains.
